attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"One assumes they expect the rest of us to just hand over the credits.","severity":"minor","reason":"'credits' is not RimWorld currency (silver); framed as a guess but the currency is off-world vocabulary"},{"span":"They seem to be weathering the Imperial demands with their usual stoicism.","severity":"minor","reason":"hedged with 'seem', but implies the Covenant is subject to the demands and has a known 'usual' behaviour, neither of which the briefing gives"}],"voice":3,"clarity":4,"tone":3,"overall":3,"comment":"It leads correctly with the new toll demand and stays accurate, but the items are short and thin, the second item's wit is weak, and 'credits' is off-setting.
